title: The Works: speeds a minute
lines: A piece's card says what it does a minute, in place of the seconds it takes for one: what a gatherer gathers, a machine makes, a Study takes in, a boiler burns and a belt carries. A belt carries 150, 200 or 300 things a minute by its grade.

Every speed in the Works is written the same way, as a number and /min: on cards, in the Items list, on the research screen and in what a higher grade does. Under 10 it has one decimal, so a grade I workshop makes 7.5–20 /min.

more.head: Also
points: A thing's card says how many a minute its machine makes.
Numbers of 1,000 and more have their comma everywhere, as in prices and pay on cards and health in The Little Raid.
